TimeeroAPIKeyCredential.title: Timeero API Key
TimeeroAPIKeyCredential.x-credential-instructions: In Timeero, open Integrations > Public API > Configuration and copy your API key. Paste only the key. Timeero API keys have administrative access; NoClick sends yours directly in the Authorization header.

TimeeroApproveTimesheetsConfig.description: Approve Timesheets using one documented API operation.

ids.description: An array of timesheet IDs that should be approved in a single request.
ids.title: Ids

mute_notification.description: Indicates whether approval notifications should be muted for this action. When set to true, approval notifications will not be sent to users. If false or omitted, users will receive a notification after their timesheets are approved.
mute_notification.title: Mute Notification

TimeeroClockInConfig.description: Clock In using one documented API operation.

user_id.description: The unique ID of the user who is clocking in.
user_id.title: User Id

job_id.description: The ID of the job or project the user is clocking in for. this is required based on company settings.
job_id.title: Job Id

task_id.description: The specific task ID under the job. If not applicable, this value can be set to null. this is required based on company settings.
task_id.title: Task Id

clock_in_time.description: The exact date and time when the user clocked in. This should be provided in ISO 8601 format, e.g YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS±HH:MM.
clock_in_time.title: Clock In Time

timezone.description: The user’s local timezone at the time of clock-in, formatted as an IANA timezone identifier.
timezone.title: Timezone

latitude.description: The latitude coordinate where the user clocked in. Used for location tracking and geofencing validation.
latitude.title: Latitude

longitude.description: The longitude coordinate where the user clocked in. Used for location tracking and geofencing validation.
longitude.title: Longitude

TimeeroClockInConfig.title: TimeeroClockInConfig

TimeeroClockOutConfig.description: Clock Out using one documented API operation.

user_id.description: The unique ID of the user who is clocking out.
user_id.title: User Id

clock_out_time.description: The exact date and time when the user clocked out. Must be later than the corresponding clock-in time and formatted in ISO 8601.  e.g YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS±HH:MM.
clock_out_time.title: Clock Out Time

timezone.description: The user’s local timezone at the moment of clock-out, provided as an IANA timezone identifier.
timezone.title: Timezone

latitude.description: The latitude coordinate where the user clocked out. Used for location verification and geofence enforcement.
latitude.title: Latitude

longitude.description: The longitude coordinate where the user clocked out. Used for location verification and geofence enforcement.
longitude.title: Longitude

TimeeroCreateJobConfig.description: Create Job using one documented API operation.

description.description: A brief description of the job.
description.title: Description

track_mileage.description: Indicates whether mileage tracking is enabled for the job
track_mileage.title: Track Mileage

require_geofence.description: Indicates whether users must be within the geofence to perform job-related actions. All the fields are optional except street, city, state, zip_code and country are required when require_geofence is true or 1 and latitude and longitude are not provided.
require_geofence.title: Require Geofence

street.description: The street address of the job location.
street.title: Street

landmark.description: A nearby landmark to help identify the job location.
landmark.title: Landmark

state.description: The state or region where the job is located.
state.title: State

city.description: The city where the job is located.
city.title: City

zip_code.description: The ZIP or postal code of the job location.
zip_code.title: Zip Code

country.description: The country where the job is located.
country.title: Country

latitude.description: The latitude coordinate of the job location.
latitude.title: Latitude

longitude.description: The longitude coordinate of the job location.
longitude.title: Longitude

radius.description: The geofence radius around the job location, in meters.
radius.title: Radius

contact_required.description: Indicates whether a contact person is required for the job (true = required, false = not required). contact_name, contact_phone, contact_mobile, and contact_email are required when contact_required is true.
contact_required.title: Contact Required

contact_name.description: The name of the job contact person.
contact_name.title: Contact Name

contact_phone.description: The phone number of the job contact person.
contact_phone.title: Contact Phone

contact_mobile.description: The mobile number of the job contact person.
contact_mobile.title: Contact Mobile

contact_email.description: The email address of the job contact person.
contact_email.title: Contact Email

geofence_members.description: A list of user IDs allowed to access or operate within the job’s geofence.
geofence_members.title: Geofence Members

users.description: A list of user IDs assigned to the job.

TimeeroCreateTimesheetConfig.description: Create Timesheet using one documented API operation.

user_id.description: The ID of the timesheet owner
user_id.title: User Id

start.description: The date and time when the user clocked in, in ISO 8601 format, e.g: YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS±HH:MM.
start.title: Start

end.description: The date and time when the user clocked out, in ISO 8601 format: YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS±HH:MM. Set to null if the user is still clocked in.
end.title: End

job_id.description: The ID of the job associated with the timesheet entry.
job_id.title: Job Id

task_id.description: The ID of the task associated with the timesheet entry.
task_id.title: Task Id

mileage.description: The distance(in miles) traveled during the timesheet period.
mileage.title: Mileage

clock_in_timezone.description: The timezone in which the clock-in time was recorded. The company's timezone will be used if none is provided. And it must match the offset when ISO 8601 offset is set.
clock_in_timezone.title: Clock In Timezone

clock_out_timezone.description: The timezone in which the clock-out time was recorded. Set to null if the user has not clocked out yet. The company's timezone will be used if none is provided. And it must match the ISO 8601 offset when set.
clock_out_timezone.title: Clock Out Timezone

notes.description: Additional notes or comments for the timesheet entry.
